# General

## Input folders

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `imc_files_folder` | `str` | `IMC_files` | `basic` | Folder containing raw IMC input files in MCD or TXT format. | Use this as the primary folder for raw IMC files. |
| `metadata_folder` | `str` | `metadata` | `basic` | Folder containing pipeline metadata and panel tables. | Keep metadata.csv and panel.csv in this folder unless a stage overrides it. |

## Observation columns

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `case_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Optional case or sample identifier column in adata.obs. | Set this for case-level summaries and statistical comparisons. |
| `roi_obs` | `str` | `ROI` | `basic` | ROI identifier column in adata.obs. | Values should identify the imaging region associated with each cell. |
| `metadata_obs` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional metadata columns used in QC and grouped summaries. | List stable adata.obs columns that should appear in downstream summaries. |
| `master_index_obs` | `str` | `Master_Index` | `advanced` | Stable per-cell identifier column in adata.obs. | Keep this stable across stages so cells can be matched after filtering or remapping. |

## Analysis groups

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `groupby_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Primary adata.obs column used for cross-condition analyses. | Choose the main experimental grouping variable, such as treatment or outcome. |
| `groupby_obs_groups` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional ordered subset of values from groupby_obs to analyse. | Leave unset to use all observed groups, or list groups in the desired display order. |
| `groupby_obs_primary_pairwise` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Preferred two-group subset for pairwise comparisons. | Provide two values from groupby_obs_groups when one comparison should be prioritised. |

## Population annotations

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `population_obs_all` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Population or cluster annotation columns available to downstream stages. | List adata.obs columns containing cell population or clustering labels. |
| `population_obs_primary` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `basic` | Primary population annotation column used by downstream analyses. | Set this to the preferred final cell population label column. |
| `compartment_obs` | `Optional[str]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional tissue-compartment annotation column in adata.obs. | Set this when abundance or spatial outputs should be stratified by tissue compartment. |
| `compartment_obs_list` | `Optional[List[str]]` | `null` | `advanced` | Optional ordered subset of tissue compartments to analyse separately. | Leave unset to use all compartments or provide the desired subset and order. |

## Spatial coordinates

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `spatial_key` | `str` | `spatial` | `advanced` | Canonical adata.obsm key containing XY spatial coordinates. | Change only when coordinates are stored under a different obsm key. |
| `x_coord_obs` | `str` | `X_loc` | `advanced` | Fallback adata.obs column containing X coordinates. | Used when the configured spatial_key is unavailable. |
| `y_coord_obs` | `str` | `Y_loc` | `advanced` | Fallback adata.obs column containing Y coordinates. | Used when the configured spatial_key is unavailable. |

## AnnData and execution

| Field | Type | Default | Level | Description | Advice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anndata_path` | `str` | `anndata.h5ad` | `basic` | Canonical AnnData file path used across pipeline stages. | Use a path relative to the dataset working directory unless an absolute path is required. |
| `anndata_stage_run_mode` | `str` | `repeat` | `advanced` | Default policy for rerunning stages recorded in AnnData. | Use repeat, skip, or intelligent according to the desired stage rerun behaviour. |
| `anndata_uns_log_key` | `str` | `pipeline_stage_log` | `expert` | AnnData.uns key used to store pipeline stage history and config snapshots. | Keep the default unless integrating with an existing AnnData logging convention. |
